results.title: Trash Mountain
results.overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

results.title: The Warmth Of Dance
results.overview: A famous TV host, who grew up without parents and with a painful past, sees his brilliant career and power called into question during a train journey from Rome to Milan.

results.title: Pretty Boys
results.overview: Stuck in the summer heat. Melting ice cream, and barking dogs. Hot sidewalks, and pretty girls. Cool nights, and bloody fights. Three friends, they only had each other.

results.title: Wrath of the Gods
results.overview: Young, grieving widow Anna returns to Hel Island to bury her late husband after his suicide. She is cast out by the eccentric locals for being a symbol of bad luck and evil. When children start going missing the island is forced to reckon with its dark history of familial abuse and the terrifying beast-like forces of the sea.

results.title: Borley Rectory: The Awakening
results.overview: In 1900, young Reverend Henry Bull and his sister, Kitty, are tasked with taking over the duties of their family home in Essex, a majestic Victorian mansion built on the site of an old monastery. Unaware of the sinister forces that lurk within, the pair are soon confronted by terrifying paranormal activities that threaten their loved ones. Desperate to protect themselves from the demonic intrusion, they call upon the services of a trusted family friend to investigate the origins of the vengeful ghosts which haunt their property. But these are spirits who will not rest, and Borley Rectory is doomed to gain a chilling reputation, as the most haunted house in all of Britain.

results.title: Super Jimni
results.overview: In a rural community plagued by health crises, corruption, and drug mafias, Veena fights to protect an abused child while grappling with her estranged, ailing mother and her drug-addicted daughter.

results.title: A Casa
results.overview: In the 1950s, the Santo Inácio Re-education Centre is ruled by a woman who subjects supposedly troubled young people to cruel discipline. Decades later, a group of students enters the abandoned building for a school assignment and awakens a presence that has remained within its walls. In the present day, other young people take shelter from a storm and discover that the house is still haunted by its past. Separated by time, the three groups confront the same evil and must rely on one another to survive.

results.title: Forest of the Marauder
results.overview: A young medic from the Great War is dragged on a hunt by his employer and fellow veteran Orion. Unbeknownst to them, in this forest- they are more akin to prey than predators.

results.title: Concerto di Capodanno La Fenice 2026
results.overview: From Venice's Teatro La Fenice, the traditional New Year's Concert conducted by Maestro Michele Mariotti, featuring arias, duets, and choral pieces performed by soloists Rosa Feola and Jonathan Tetelman. The event will be enhanced by dance performances by étoiles Eleonora Abbagnato and Friedemann Vogel.

results.title: The Death of Klinghoffer
results.overview: An opera in a prologue and two acts by John Adams, with a libretto by Alice Goodman, inspired by the 1985 hijacking of the cruise ship Achille Lauro. Conducted by Lawrence Renes, directed and designed by Luca Guadagnino. A new production by the Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino.

results.title: The Ghost Marriage
results.overview: Actress Liu Qing is haunted by evil spirits every night, blurring the lines between her on-screen and real lives. The ghost of her ghost marriage relentlessly pursues her, revealing a horrifying scheme built on the blood of human lives beneath her glamorous exterior. A male doctor goes to the countryside to provide free medical care and is shocked to discover that the mentally unstable village woman is actually a former popular actress. A village bully's evil conspiracy conceals a century-old mystery, and a terrifying curse from a new era quietly looms. Can this series of bizarre events truly be brought to an end?

results.title: Tele XXX
results.overview: A middle-aged recluse spirals into sexual mania when he is seduced by his television.

results.title: Le cas Meloni
results.overview: Who is Giorgia Meloni, Italy’s Prime Minister since 2022, and how does she carry out her duties as head of state? How has a 45-year-old woman managed to win over a fragmented and deeply patriarchal Italy by ascending to the most powerful political office in her country and making her mark on the international stage? What fascist legacy does she carry?

results.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
results.overview: A handsome young man trades his soul so that his portrait ages while he stays eternally young.

results.title: Small Triumph
results.overview: A painter struggles with the toughest model she's ever had: her daughter.

results.title: Akshara
results.overview: Akshara is an emotional social-family drama that explores women’s identity, relationships, family values, and social challenges. The story follows a woman’s journey through emotional struggles, relationship conflicts, and societal expectations while searching for her own identity and choices.

results.title: The Ectomilkers
results.overview: Sergeant and Gideon are tasked with navigating a godless land- helping clients with their paranormal hunting business.
